name: Duelist of the Mind
oracle_text:
Flying, vigilance
Duelist of the Mind's power is equal to the number of cards you've drawn this turn.
Whenever you commit a crime, you may draw a card. If you do, discard a card. This ability triggers only once each turn.
blocked_sentences: Whenever you commit a crime, you may draw a card. If you do, discard a card. This ability triggers only once each turn

needs.what: a trigger event fired once per spell cast or ability put on the stack whose targets include one of the controller's opponents, a permanent or spell an opponent of that controller controls, or a card in an opponent's graveyard (rule 700.13), filterable by who committed the crime (here: the trigger's controller, 'you'); combined with the existing max_per_turn: 1 for 'triggers only once each turn'
needs.why_existing_wont_do: becomes_target fires per targeted object and only for permanents, so it misses targeting a player or graveyard cards and would fire multiple times for one spell with several targets; spell_cast and ability_activated carry no information about whether the targets belong to an opponent; the engine has no crime concept at all. The rest of the card is expressible: the power line is a set_pt static reading cards_drawn_this_turn, and the loot is may + draw then discard
